citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 1 (contract term; flows down CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.1)
trigger: Company confirms a cyber incident related to the products or services it supplies to the utility (for example the TMU firmware library, the configuration tool, field laptops, or access to utility systems)
deadline: Within 48 hours after confirmation (contract deadline, not a NERC requirement)
notify: Each addendum utility's designated security contact, by the method in its addendum
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual. Sent by the Contracts and Compliance Manager after counsel review
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 2 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.2 flow-down)
deadline: Ongoing until closure; share indicators and recovery steps for supplied products
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 3 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.3 flow-down)
trigger: A field technician's credentials for a utility's remote or onsite access may be compromised (for example an encrypted or stolen field laptop), or access should otherwise no longer be granted
notify: Each utility where the technician holds access
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual. Sent by the Field Service Manager
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 4 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.4 flow-down)
trigger: The investigation finds a vulnerability in supplied TMU firmware, the configuration tool, or other supplied software
deadline: Within 30 days of the company knowing of it
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual. Sent by the VP Engineering
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

obligation: Delivery-impact notice to other utility and developer customers
trigger: Production delay affecting committed or storm-restoration deliveries
deadline: Per each supply agreement (as soon as the delay is known)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - business and contractual, not legal

citation: Federal contract terms; FAR 52.204-21 has no incident reporting paragraph
trigger: Incident delays deliveries under the federal contract or affects FCI
deadline: No cyber incident reporting duty under FAR 52.204-21. Notify of any delivery schedule impact under the contract's terms (confirm with counsel)

trigger: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment identified during response or rebuild
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification; further information within 10 business days

obligation: Kaspersky covered article provided to the Government
trigger: A Kaspersky Lab covered article is identified in anything provided to the Government under the contract
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification; further information within 10 business days

trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents (employee and former employee HR and payroll records on the file server or in the ERP)
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach (law enforcement delay allowed on written request)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if employee personal information was accessed or acquired

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida (current and former employees count)
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if 500 or more Florida individuals

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice required to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time

obligation: Third-party agent breach notice to the company (inbound)
trigger: The MSP, payroll provider, or another third-party agent has a breach of the company's personal information
deadline: Agent must notify the company within 10 days after determining the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - track for the MSP and payroll provider

trigger: Affected employees who live outside Florida
notify: Residents and regulators per each state's law

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
deadline: Before any payment; reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved); FBI or CISA

obligation: Voluntary report to law enforcement and CISA
deadline: As soon as practicable (target within 24 hours of declaration)
notify: FBI field office or IC3; CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - voluntary; supports OFAC mitigation and threat sharing with the sector

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident and ransom payment reports (PROPOSED - not in effect)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment
deadline: Proposed only: 72 hours after reasonable belief a covered cyber incident occurred; 24 hours after a ransom payment
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-26. If finalized as proposed, the company would be covered (NAICS subsector 335). Report voluntarily now

trigger: Cyber incident affecting covered defense information
applies_at_this_tier: No - no DoD contracts or subcontracts; recorded for completeness

deadline: Per policy; call the carrier breach hotline before hiring vendors
notify: Carrier breach hotline (breach coach, forensic panel)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual, not legal. Called by the Controller

obligation: MSP incident notice to the company (inbound)
trigger: The MSP detects an incident affecting company systems or its own RMM tool
deadline: No deadline in the current contract; a 24-hour notice term is being added (P01 R-014)
